## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) documentation and followed the project's code style guidelines.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, were added the way *Dependencies* in `.squad/stack.md` prescribes.
